content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-248. - Applicability of other provisions.
content.summary:
The
procedures established in article III relating to the collection of sales and use
               tax, including any provisions for penalty, shall be applicable to the lodging tax
               unless such provisions conflict with the provisions of this article.
(Code 1981, § 31-108; Ord. No. 37…
